summary: The PR addresses the issue of making the 'Other parameters' section respect the napoleon_use_param configuration, but there are some concerns regarding test coverage and potential behavioral changes.

issues.description: There are no additional tests added to verify the new behavior of the 'Other parameters' section when napoleon_use_param is True. This makes it difficult to ensure that the change behaves as expected in all scenarios.

Changing the behavior of the 'Other parameters' section may introduce regressions for users who rely on the current behavior. It is important to consider how this change will affect existing documentation and ensure that it does not break any existing functionality.
